purpose: Development pilot: skill effects on lower-cost translators and full-pipeline economics; not a confirmation holdout.

source.status: Previously evaluated sources; development use only. No prior Russian outputs supplied.

pricing.basis: API list-price equivalent; not actual Codex subscription billing
pricing.service_tier: Standard assumed; tier not attested by CLI usage
pricing.cache_write_assumption: cache_write_input_tokens treated as subset of input_tokens; separate cold-cost scenario reported. Positive cache-write counts require review of accounting semantics.

escalation.flag: at least one confirmed major/critical, unresolved meaning, or two confirmed minor fidelity issues

confirmation_required: Fresh60+item,6+work holdout and qualified bilingual review before general quality claim or mandatory default.

pilot_rules.scope: Development signal only, no automatic default or proven literary claim
pilot_rules.within_model_signal: Complete coverage; no new accepted critical or major error relative to plain; semantic-error improvement on>=2items OR prose preference net>=2 without increased calque count; no more1newminor semantic harm; nonnegative direction in>=2works.
pilot_rules.ranking: Among signal arms rank by confirmed critical count, major count, total fidelity count, prose preference loss to anchor, then cold translation+full planning cost. If no arm signals, choose plain for economic baseline; do not label it skill improvement.
pilot_rules.economic_observed_gate: After actual bounded routing: no critical/unresolved production flags, major error density within0.5per1000sourcewords of anchor, decisive prose losses to anchor<=10%ofcorpus, cold total pipeline cost<=80%of equally audited anchor. Internal pilot gate only.
pilot_rules.production_routing_uses: Raw evidence-backed online audit flags without a free human/model adjudicator; charge false-positive escalation too. Final research adjudication is separate.
pilot_rules.strong_baseline_routing: Sol anchor also receives one online audit; if flagged, one Sol correction+reaudit, both charged.
pilot_rules.bootstrap: Work-stratified item bootstrap and per-work counts are descriptive; no population-level certainty from3works.
pilot_rules.unique_issue_key: source_id + anonymous candidate_id + final category + source_quote; coalesce exact duplicate evidence across audit contexts using max severity; aliases inherit once.
pilot_rules.new_harm_key: category+source_quote absent in same-model plain accepted issues
pilot_rules.prose_preference: One blinded prose/voice context, no majority claim. Exact duplicate text pairs deterministic tie; empty/missing wronglanguage automatically failure.
pilot_rules.acceptance: No raw online major/critical/unresolved or2minor semantic flags and complete translator coverage. Pending flags count as unaccepted until actual re-audit clears them.
pilot_rules.cost_signal_cap: guard cold cost<=1.25plain; brief/memory fullplanner+translator cold cost<=1.5plain. Opportunities failing this cap are quality observations only.
